Also today the app says I still have three tasks to do, but I know I only have two. 

It’s frustrating because I like the simple interface, but it just feels like there’s so much more that could be offered for the premium price asked. Many other types of app in the App Store provide more functionality, are more sophisticated and you can see and feel what you are paying for in terms of development and delivery, for less cost. So I’d love to continue with it, but the incessant badgering to upgrade to a bundle with subscription pricing for features I don’t need or want is making it almost unusable. Every time I open the app. And I do mean EVERY SINGLE TIME! I’m presented with a full screen upgrade message I have to wait to dismiss, with a ‘limited time’ countdown that runs out and then just starts over. After which an ever present banner obscures the bottom of the screen.

It’s a pretty bad sign when an otherwise happy user who actively likes and wants to use the product is so put off by such and utterly infuriating and apparently never ending ‘offer’ they take to an angry 1-star review just to say: ‘No, I’m okay thanks, just let me use the thing I paid for and let me turn off this promo PERMANENTLY.’ 🤯

title: Ruined by the recent update
body: I had been using this app as a tool to manage memory problems caused by a disability. The most useful part for me was the design on the widget which meant I could easily view a large portion of me task list from the widget page, completed tasks disappeared from the widget and a new task automatically appeared at the bottom of the list (arranged by a priority I set myself) I found this feature so useful and the format worked so well for me that I was happy to pay for a yearly subscription.  Unfortunately the new update has made such hugely detrimental changes to this feature that the app is now not useful to me. It’s quite frustrating as it had taken me some time to find the right app for me to manage my disabilities and this was really working well, it’s no longer what I paid for and it’s quite annoying to now have the app change without warning or reason to something different to what i actually paid for. title: Simple with Huge Pottential
body:
DONE is a great and has the opportunity to grow into a powerful habit app. 

Personal Overview

DONE is simple and intuitive.
The app tracks your progress and uses streaks as a rewarding system.

What I enjoy in DONE

The simplicity and abstraction really grab me as well as that the app team does not beg you for money, does not frustrate you with ads, does not implement subscription fees and leaves you alone to choose whether you want to pay a one time fee to help them continue building this wonderful app!

What could improve?

The app rewarding system needs to trigger a craving on a subconcious level so the it can be really effective. One way this could be achieved is mental awards: Collecting points/medals, personal progress bar, unlocking hidden rewards.

Why? Personal example:

I have the habit to drink beer. 3-4 per day sometimes even more. That habit by itself could be 5 times stronger than the desire to do a simple streak. 
Mood changes throughout the day and its really easy to skip a streak.

title: Helping me get life on track
body:
In a line: For me (someone with ADHD) this app is everything you could ever need to build useful routines, and quit less useful habits, personalised to your liking ❤️ would highly recommend this app! 

Longer answer: I’m an ADHD sufferer, and as a result it is hard to keep my brain on track or establish any kind of meaningful routine due to, among other things, an increased level of unconscious impulsivity. 

This app has been a complete game changer as it acts as a memory bank, allowing me to work towards building a routine day by day, week by week, month by month, setting goals that have a noticeable feeling of achievement when each task is completed. 

Being able to set morning/evening reminders is also great because it helps train my mind to check in and focus on the challenges ahead, whilst the customisation options help me categorise all my habits with absolute ease. 

Overall, a fantastic app that’s helping me so much, thanks folks ❤️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
